scope: Visual/privacy review of the 20 successful public mock workflow attachments only. These remain separate from the 30 formal presentation frames. This does not certify authenticated API roles, private photos, server persistence or native Word opening.
method: Opened all 20 actual PNGs individually using view_image; independently matched each to its browser-results.json attachment SHA256 and recorded dimensions.

steps: Open the laboratory in ordinary mode at 375×812.
Leave the page at the top and inspect the status strip immediately below the header.
findings.expected: The data-source label can be read; its wording identifies browser/mock data.
findings.actual: The right edge clips the RU label «Тестовый источник в браузере» and KK label «Браузердегі сынақ деректері»; the final words are not fully visible in the default viewport.
findings.documentOverflow: Both corresponding lab tests passed document.scrollWidth <= document.clientWidth; this observation is clipping inside the strip, not demonstrated page overflow.
findings.impact: Budget/water/goal controls remain visible; calculations are not implicated. Recoverability by strip scrolling/title was not independently inspected.

findings.area: public laboratory and mobile Outcomes screenshots
findings.observation: Screenshots are taken near page top; lab result cards and mobile Outcomes numerical values are below the viewport.
findings.impact: Usable as completed workflow/control evidence alongside assertions, but not as presentation images proving fully visible calculated plans. Keep formal 30-frame result-focused archive separate.

privacy: Only synthetic demo session labels and public OSM source names are visible; no passwords, private person data, tokens or real report photographs.
